(Currently amended) 1) Composition comprising a compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, wherein the compound of formula I is distinct from indole derivatives.

(Currently amended) 3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the composition is specifically formulated for topical application to enhance skin health.

(Currently amended) 4) Composition according to one or more of Claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, emphasizing a concentration effective for prophylactic use.

(Currently amended) 6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5 ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight for enhancing skin moisture retention.

(Currently amended) 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition aimed at improving skin health and preventing skin conditions.

(Currently amended) 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, particularly targeting acne vulgaris and related conditions.

(Currently amended) 9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development, providing a comprehensive approach to skin and hair health.

(Currently amended) 10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair with a focus on maintenance of youthful appearance.

(Currently amended) 11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as a skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent while addressing hyperpigmentation.

(Currently amended) 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, ensuring safe application within dermatologically acceptable limits.

(Currently amended) 13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, emphasizing preventative measures in skin care.

(Currently amended) 14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced aging processes of the human skin or human hair, specifically enhancing protective measures against environmental factors.
